subject: Emotions
title: Contagious Laughter
description: A quick win: understand Contagious Laughter.

hook.text: In 1962, a laughing epidemic in Tanzania spread through schools. Girls laughed for weeks; 14 schools shut down.

buildup.text: Laughter is 30 times more likely when you're with others. It's a social signal, not a solo emotion.

discovery.text: Mirror neurons fire when you hear laughter, pre-activating your own laugh muscles. Joy copies itself.

twist.text: Only 10-20% of laughter is in response to humor. Most laughter signals agreement, affection, or social belonging.

climax.text: Laughter evolved before language. Primates laugh during play. It's the oldest social bonding sound we have.

punchline.text: Laughter isn't about jokes. It's about connection.

quiz.question: What percentage of laughter is actually in response to humor?
